snippet.title: Vanguard Galaxy - Combat Gameplay
snippet.description:
A small glimpse into combat in Vanguard Galaxy.
In this video you’ll see a gunship in action during 2 combat missions.

Play the demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3471800/Vanguard_Galaxy/

Join the Discord:
https://discord.gg/qy9xe35hXh

Vanguard Galaxy is a relaxing game about space exploration that can be played full screen or at the bottom of your screen. Trade, fight, mine and salvage your way through a procedurally generated galaxy. Let the game idle while your autopilot handles business and builds your fortune.
